data.name: Extinction Zone
data.detailed_description:
BULLETS & BRAINS

Step into a world where every pixel drips with dread and every shadow hides a hungry corpse. EXTINCTION ZONE resurrects the golden age of gaming with a stunning twist that will have your trigger finger twitching.

SURVIVAL NOT GUARANTEED

The dead walk again, bringing the excitement of classic survival horror into grimy 2D pixel art. Navigate hand-crafted environments that pay homage to the games that made you hide under your covers as a kid.

FIGHT. SOLVE. SURVIVE

Your journey isn't only about blasting zombies into pixelated confetti. Every corridor is a puzzle, every locked door a mystery, every survivor a potential threat or ally. Uncover the dark secrets behind the outbreak as you scavenge for precious resources and use whatever weapons you can find.

UNCOVER A CONSPIRACY

The outbreak wasn't just random - it was planned. The conspiracy runs deeper than you can imagine, with clues hidden in the most unlikely places. Piece together the truth before you become another pixelated corpse in the growing army of the dead. Can you survive the night?

ENTER THE EXTINCTION ZONE

  • Exciting combat action gameplay

  • Use stealth.. or your pump action shotgun

  • Zombie conspiracy backstory with NPCs

  • Inventory management & limited resources

  • World exploration & backtracking

  • Logic & environmental puzzles

  • Retro pixel art graphics & lighting effects
